provisionalNote: The pose metric is geometric — a recovered pose against ground truth — so the Phase 2 gate does not apply to it. What IS conditional on an unmeasured constant is how much contamination reaches the solver at all: an off-sphere return is scaled by rho_room (PARAMETERS.md, 0.3, class ASSUME) before it meets the decoder threshold. So F1’s contamination percentage and the whole of F4’s threshold sweep move with a number nobody has measured, while the pose consequence OF a contaminated correspondence set does not. The consequence is measured; the dose is assumed. An earlier version of this note claimed no photometric constant entered the experiment at all, which was wrong: it counted the room’s two geometric constants and forgot its albedo.

cuts.what: One archetype, not the bench corpus.
cuts.why: Eighty solves at the default preset is nine minutes; the full corpus crossed with this grid is hours, and the experiment is about a mechanism rather than a survey.
cuts.costsTheConclusion: The magnitudes are this archetype’s. A rig with a different camera count or a different projector raster will put a different fraction of its frame on the wall, so the threshold that separates the two populations may sit elsewhere.

cuts.what: The room is a cylinder with a flat floor and ceiling, and no furniture.
cuts.why: It is the smallest closed surface that puts the pattern where the pattern goes, and its two constants are already one more assumption than PARAMETERS.md supports.
cuts.costsTheConclusion: A real gallery has a floor that is not the sphere’s own plane, doors, plinths and the guard rail, all of which are nearer than the wall and would spill harder. This is a floor on the effect, not a bound.

cuts.why: Inter-reflection was already on `capture.ts`’s list of things it does not model.
cuts.costsTheConclusion: Light that reaches the room and comes back onto the ball would raise the sphere’s own floor and narrow whatever threshold window this finds.

cuts.what: The segmentation tested is geometric, not image-space.
cuts.why: It asks whether a decoded projector pixel’s own ray reaches the nominal sphere, which uses only what the solver already holds — §1’s radius, §W’s origin, and the nominal rig. An image-space silhouette detector would be a component this project has not built.
cuts.costsTheConclusion: It inherits a dependence on the nominal being roughly right, and this design never tests a rig whose documented calibration is badly wrong. A capture where the nominal is a metre out — the bench’s own `long-throw` archetype — could segment much worse, and is untested.

cuts.what: The two mitigations are swept in separate arms, not crossed.
cuts.why: Crossing four rooms by four thresholds by four margins is 320 solves, and the cross terms answer a question nobody asked: each arm holds the other axis at its shipped value so every comparison stays a one-axis comparison.
cuts.costsTheConclusion: If a raised modulation floor and a segmentation margin interact — if, say, the floor removes exactly the annulus the margin admits — this design cannot see it.

verdict.statement: The room puts 14.1% of the accepted correspondences off the sphere, and that is enough to destroy the solve: recovered pose goes from 20.6 mm to 16365 mm, a factor of 793 on the medians, which are one seed each. Paired seed by seed that is a geometric mean of 168.3 over 5 seeds, improving 4 of them and taking the seeds no worse than the worst clean solve from 1 to 5. Raising the decoder's modulation floor from 0.02 to 0.4 recovers it, and costs a capture with no room in it a factor of 2.94 on the same measure. Segmentation at a margin of 0 does not clear the two-times bar either, but it is not a null result: it takes the median from 16365 mm to 44.0 mm, a factor of 372 on the medians, against a clean baseline of 20.6 mm. Both of those medians are one seed. Paired seed by seed that is a geometric mean of 15.7 over 5 seeds, improving 3 of them and taking the seeds no worse than the worst clean solve from 1 to 3. What it does not fix is the tail: the worst of 5 seeds is still 348115 mm. The residue is the correspondences that miss the TRUE sphere and hit the NOMINAL one, which is the dependence on the answer that this test was always going to carry.
